children: According to Kabutan, Yonhap and HKET, investors remained divided over the outlook for artificial intelligence (AI) value-chain investment as U.S. technology shares rebounded, while political turmoil in Europe weighed on sentiment; November WTI crude futures rose 2.22% to $103.66 a barrel.

Nikkei 225 futures for December 2026 delivery on the Osaka Exchange ended the night session at 64,840, down 140 points from the previous session and 76.7 points below the Nikkei 225 cash close of 64,916.7, with 10,487 contracts traded. TOPIX futures fell 21.5 points to 4,054.5.

Hong Kong's index-futures night session was closed for the day after the Chung Yeung Festival holiday, with the market reopening on Tuesday. Hong Kong ADRs mostly declined: in Hong Kong dollar terms versus local closing prices, Tencent's ADR was at HK$410.36, 1.78% lower; Alibaba's U.S. shares at HK$106.50, 2.11% lower; Meituan's ADR at HK$74.55, 1.51% lower; and the HSBC ADR at HK$145.91, 2.53% lower. GDS Holdings' ADR was 11.1% below its Hong Kong close.
Taiwan Futures Exchange data showed October 2026 TAIEX futures ended the night session at 46,691, down 78 points or 0.17%, trading between 46,497 and 47,033, with 26,868 contracts traded.

title: ASIA NIGHT SESSION | Nikkei Futures Fall 140 Points Overnight; Hong Kong Night Session Closed for Holiday
